title: CAI Content Credentials is affected by an Uncontrolled Resource Consumption vulnerability that could… (CVE-2026-122097)
description: CAI Content Credentials has an Uncontrolled Resource Consumption vulnerability (CWE-400) that can be exploited to cause application denial-of-service. Exploitation requires user interaction, such as visiting a malicious URL or interacting with a compromised web page. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity but can cause service disruption.
